title: Durable workspace memory across fresh trajectories
description: Stores a synthetic project fact in one trajectory, then starts a fresh trajectory in the same workspace and requires exact recall without writing the fact to project files.
prompt: Treat explicitly labelled durable project facts as reusable workspace memory. Never write a durable fact into project files unless asked.

files.README.md: Synthetic memory fixture. This repository intentionally contains no deployment rollback code.

steps.prompt: DURABLE PROJECT_NEBULA fact: its emergency deployment rollback code is Q7-EMBER-491. Keep it as workspace memory, do not write it to a file, and reply only ACK-MEMORY.
This is a fresh trajectory with no prior chat history. What is the exact emergency deployment rollback code for PROJECT_NEBULA? Reply with the code only.
